prompts.walk: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: complete character walking-cycle sprite sheet for OpenCareEyes, transparent RGBA. Input image 1 is the existing white ferret identity and drawing style; input image 2 is the ORIGINAL OpenCareEyes walking pose and is the anatomy/proportion reference. Redesign the awkward new quadruped walk toward the original's natural ferret anatomy. Create exactly 8 full, connected animal poses arranged in an exact 4-column by 2-row grid, all facing RIGHT. Natural low center of gravity, gently elongated slim torso, small rounded head relative to the torso (the head is at most half the torso length), short soft four-legged steps, paws stay compact and land under the shoulders, no oversized human wrists or elbows. White fur, muted pale blue shading, pink inner ears, glossy black eyes, charcoal rounded tail gently held behind and near horizontal. Cute relaxed expression, eyes and head held almost still throughout the cycle. Eight successive phases of ONE slow walk, smoothly transitioning: contact, down, passing, up, opposite contact, down, passing, up. Adjacent phases must vary ONLY leg placement and a very small torso bob, not face, body shape, size, perspective or tail silhouette. In every cell align nose, spine center and foot baseline consistently; identical camera, identical scale and body length. Put the whole animal in each cell with generous transparent margins. Draw clear four-legged contact, avoid floating paws or disconnected limbs, avoid barrel-shaped bear anatomy. Clean soft illustrated outlines like image 1 and natural body proportion like image 2. True transparent background. No captions, numbers, motion marks, ground, shadows, props, scarf, border or grid lines.
prompts.stretch: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: ONE complete full-body stretch key pose for the existing OpenCareEyes white ferret. Edit input image 1 while retaining exactly the same character identity, forward camera, face proportions, drawing style, white fur, pale blue shading, pink ears and charcoal tail. Redesign the pose into an unmistakable cute stretch: both front paws lifted up and outward beside the ears, soft bent elbows, fully connected shoulders and neck; torso elongated a little and feet planted together at the original foot baseline, eyes gently closed, tiny relaxed yawn. It should read as a slow waking-up stretch at a 192-pixel desktop size. Keep the tail natural and body gently balanced, no human hands, no crossed arms, no disconnected arms, no stiff straight human limbs. Keep the entire animal in frame with space above the paws and ears. Preserve the same body axis, original body width, and tail location as much as possible. This is a single complete connected pose, not a collage of separated body parts. True transparent RGBA background. No text, clock, snowflake, effect lines, ground, shadows or props.

selected_stretch_refinement: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: one complete transparent full-body stretching pose for the OpenCareEyes white ferret desktop pet. Input image 1 is the edit target, the currently rejected stretch. Input image 2 is the neutral character reference. Correct ONLY the stretch anatomy and weight balance while keeping the character, illustrated line style, white fur, pale blue shading, pink paw pads, charcoal tail, forward camera and gentle closed-eye yawn. The rejected target has a narrow pinched waist, overly long thin trunk and tiny crowded hind feet, making the large head feel unsupported. Redraw a compact, stable, cute stretch: torso about 20 percent shorter, waist smoothly rounded and much fuller (no hourglass narrowing), pelvis/hips visibly broad enough to support the head; two short rounded hind legs visible with hind paws planted slightly apart below the hips, wider than in the target, toes pointing forward, belly rests above the legs rather than ending directly in tiny feet. Reduce the head size slightly (about 10 percent) while preserving identity. Both front paws lift outward beside the ears, softly bent elbows and fully connected shoulders, no long skinny arms. Keep a relaxed, balanced center of gravity; the lower half must carry visual weight instead of resembling a tapered thin pole. Whole body and tail in frame, generous margins, truly transparent RGBA background. Do not add any props, scenery, ground, shadow, text, checkerboard or motion effects. ONE complete connected animal, not separated parts.
stretch_refinement_reason: User found the first stretch top-heavy: thin long waist and tiny crowded hind paws. Rebalanced toward a compact full lower body and separated planted paws.
selected_drawn_stretch_sequence_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: a real hand-drawn 6-frame full-character stretching animation sprite sheet for OpenCareEyes. Input image 1 is the neutral white ferret identity and compact torso reference; input image 2 is the raised-paw pose reference, whose lower-body balance is acceptable. Create EXACTLY SIX complete full-body poses in a landscape 3-column by 2-row grid, read left to right, top to bottom. All six poses face FORWARD. They are six consecutive small steps of ONE gentle stretch. Frame 1: eyes softly closed, tiny yawn, both front paws low beside upper belly. Frame 2: paws lift out near the chest. Frame 3: paws rise to shoulder height. Frame 4: paws beside the cheeks. Frame 5: paws beside the ears. Frame 6: a relaxed raised-paw stretch with short softly bent elbows. In ALL SIX cells the face, head angle, ears, head size, compact rounded torso, broad unpinched waist, hips, planted hind legs, slightly separated hind paws and charcoal tail MUST be the SAME size, shape and location. The closed-eye gentle yawn expression must stay the SAME throughout. ONLY the front paws and forearms progressively change position. Draw each intermediate anatomy completely; attached shoulders and natural elbows, no stretched rubber limbs. Do not tilt, shrink, squeeze, rotate, warp or morph the head, face, belly, legs or tail. Do not make a narrow hourglass waist or long thin body. Use exactly the same forward camera and neutral proportions as image 1. Both hind paws must remain planted slightly apart at the same baseline, well balanced under hips. Cute complete connected animal, white fur, pale blue shading, pink inner ears and paw pads, gentle illustrated black outlines. Each cell includes the WHOLE animal with generous transparent padding, nothing cropped. Match spine center and foot baseline identically across cells. TRUE transparent RGBA background, no checkerboard, text, grid lines, numbers, labels, effects, props, ground or shadows. Produce complete successive drawings suitable for direct sprite playback; no deformed interpolated images.
stretch_sequence_reason: User identified deformation in interpolated stretch frames. Removed all stretch morphing; use six complete drawn arm phases with an unchanged forward camera and stable lower-body support.
